systems.system: Identification biométrique des effectifs de la PNC (fichier biométrique unique des policiers)
systems.country_label: identification biométrique des effectifs de la Police nationale congolaise
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior and the PNC; executed by the company Africa Business Agency (ABA)
systems.tiers: Entered its operational phase on 9 July 2026; to be deployed progressively in the 26 provinces, Kinshasa as pilot province; biometric enrolment not yet launched

note: The only system is a biometric file of police officers for staff, payroll and career management, class personnel; nothing is stated about station records.
